source.house: agentskills.io specification: the description should say when to use the skill; the English trigger clause test is a house rule (eva.py comments; no dated record)

rules.message: description has an English trigger clause outside quotes (sentence-initial 'Use when ...', 'Used when ...', 'Use this skill when ...', 'Use for/to ... when ...', 'Invoke when ...', 'Trigger when ...', '... use this skill when ...', 'This skill should be used when ...', 'Read this skill before ...') with a concrete condition{clause}
rules.fix: Start a sentence of the description with an English trigger clause (for example 'Use when the user asks to summarize a PDF.') and write a concrete condition of {min_words} or more words after 'when' or 'before'. These do not count: 'Use this.', passive forms ('files loaded when', 'Applies to X when', 'This skill is loaded when'), negations ('Do not use when', 'Skip this skill when'), sentences inside quotes, and conditions written only in Korean.

source.house: Claude skill authoring best practices: always write the description in third person (cited in eva.py; no dated record)

rules.fix: Write the description in the third person (for example 'Processes Excel files...' instead of 'I can help you...' or 'You can use this...'). Remove the first- and second-person words {words}.
